notes.title: Official Release: Swanky Paint Alpha +11 is now here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/40c883652adee0255dff73a634906a3501412820.gif[/img]

[b]Thank you for being here and supporting Swanky Paint all these years![/b]

When we first started developing, we didn't know it was going to grow to become the software that it is now. This was more a tiny experiment and tribute to the fantastic Deluxe Paint.

[h1]Swanky Paint will remain to be a niche application for those who love creating within the retro limitations of old hardware in years to come.[/h1]

We've got so many things we want to show and implement - but there are only the two of us developing this in our spare time so development is slow but surely. Thank you for your patience!

[b]We hope you enjoy the new features and additions.[/b] It has been an intense few months leading up to this release. And we hope you stick around for the new things coming to our beloved pixel pushing application!

[h1]xoxo[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/fe6e73834eb0e327ff5c6b893b11dac597b5861e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Swanky Paint Alpha +11 : Part 5 FINALE - Recap & Wrap up
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mkoi1AzOL6I
[h1]We’re almost there! The official release of Alpha +11 is tomorrow![/h1]

This will be the last video in the series before the launch but we’ve had so much fun doing them, we might peep in new updates with more ‘How to’ videos so watch out for those.

[b]By the way, if you ever want us to do a specific video about a feature or certain techniques, drop us a note![/b]

Without further ado, here be the new things and fixes for the new version.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/f9f07d3869961691973557163c14962662b640ed.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] History is saved with each file so you can undo even after you close a file.
Ctrl+Z - undo
Ctrl+Y - redo
Shift+U - undo
U still works the same (does a redo until there is no redo available - in which case, it does an undo)
[*] Wrap mode now available in Config > Prefs > Wrap (preview tiling in drawing area)
[*] Draw anywhere in tiles, updates in drawing area
[*] Added Dither
Dither window appears when you load true color images
[*] Access all available windows in current window
Click > to Windows...
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/fadf45c85f4b541e4a8efcb06fa757284f802529.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed temporary image ghosts
[*] Fixed brush ghosting
[*] Fixed Layer > Process > Flatten Layers doesn't work (creates a new image)
[*] Fixed Layers being remembered in Config -> Prefs when saved
[*] Fixed Brush pickup outside draw area error
[*] Fixed Preferences for layers (no longer set to global)
[*] Fixed Frame > Add a frame (Shift+2 still works)
[*] Fixed Undo with image resize
[*] Fixed Undo with palette remap
[*] Fixed Swapping frames crashing application
[*] Fixed number updating for Sliders in Colors
[*] Capitalise 'Contrast' in Dither window
[*] Fixed Dither to update values at 100% image scale
[*] Fixed typo Dither > Red goes up to 180 when it should be 100
[*] Fixed Layer compositing slowing down application
[*] Fixed Frames duplicate
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/2e4827774fb2e91ef3caf2ea17c3d70a5e18e524.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Display new icons for tools when in use
[*] Added Pipette icon
[*] Added Pr icon (processing - applying attribute clash / reduce color palette / apply effect over current image)
[*] Added Slide icon
[*] RemapTo palette and brush will not dither by default
[*] Added hover text to newer tools
[*] Include palette in New image presets
[*] Display current Paint mode
[*] Regroup menu drop downs
[*] Allow Dither for paletted files
[*] Update Images menu with preferences and image list
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/855b0289f560f49043a9d2516a7a9b2be6d4a524.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] When opening / loading / saving an image, you can edit the url of the file destination
[*] Add custom 8-bit palettes or presets to [code]$HOME/Pictures/swankypaint/presets[/code]
We scan for these files at startup and add them to the Palette Editor menu.
[b]Palette[/b] - filename.pal.png
[b]Preset[/b] - filename.set.png
[/list]


[b]It's almost time! We're posting videos of the new features you'll be seeing in the next version of Swanky Paint leading up to the official release party on the 4th of August, 2018 so see you next time![/b]

notes.title: Swanky Paint Alpha +11 : Part 4 - Image Resize & User Interface
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cQqOrauxGG8
[h1][b]IMAGE RESIZE[/b] is a new feature that will enhance the way you organise your workspace.[/h1]

Trim off excess space easily by cropping your current image or increase your canvas to accommodate more assets.

Using the 'Anchor', you can specify from where your image is resized or cropped. The Image Size Adjuster window also lets you add new layers to your current image as well as resize your canvas, at the same time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/bee21959e091a16dd62dab1d3355a28765f2ee4a.gif[/img]
[i]Resizing an image in various ways[/i]

Have a go at this new feature and tell us what you think! [b]We want to improve the window interface for this feature so your feedback will help tremendously.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/edeb12e26782a1b5bb4c9ec8f9c8ddc0c9206126.gif[/img]
[i]Scale your windows up to see better[/i]

With the new user interface design and structure, we now have our own windows system.

This gives us complete control over the application and allows us to do magical things like saving your preferences (which includes the layout of where the toolbox and preview area lives), creating our own buttons and menus and having the windows scale to accommodate legibility. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/2a12802c409203f1d41cd8c2258fbe9272045c40.gif[/img]
[i]Windows inception - we put windows in your windows[/i]

You now have access to all other windows from a currently opened window. This should make it easier for you to get to where you want without having to navigate to the menu bar. It's the little things, innit?

[b]It's almost time! We're posting videos of the new features you'll be seeing in the next version of Swanky Paint leading up to the official release party on the 4th of August, 2018 so see you next time![/b]

notes.title: Swanky Paint Alpha +11 : Part 3 - Layers, Frames & WRAP MODE
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V5KQqkZrovg
[h1]The new [b]Wrap Mode[/b] feature allows tile previewing which is useful for textures and things that need to be repeated when used as backdrops and background assets.[/h1]

As game artists, an obviously repeated pattern is an eyesore, especially at small samples. This should make it easier to work out a more natural looking placement for your pixel art and games.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/272a123a1daaba3f2140fed347e2d4b0184ea912.gif[/img]
[i]Tiling preview[/i]

With this new feature, artists are able to draw anywhere on the screen so you're not limited to just the drawing area. This is because [b]we update your canvas regardless of where you paint your pixels[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/2cf872b50a1a69c6ecf72113f1806a75a82f8ed6.gif[/img]
[i]Converting a spritesheet into different formats[/i]

Chop up your spritesheet easily into frames. Just use 'brush pickup' to select the dimension of one character and then choose 'Anim from SpriteSheet' under the Image dropdown.

You can always swap frames to layers, or vice versa, under the same dropdown and flatten back the spritesheet into a single image by adjusting the values to a single layer in the Layer window.

[b]We're posting videos of the new features you'll be seeing in the next version of Swanky Paint leading up to the official release party on the 4th of August, 2018 so see you next time![/b]

notes.title: Swanky Paint Alpha +11: Part 2 - DITHERING
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lE-vTXyTKU0
[h1][b]DITHERING[/b] is now an option for paletted and true colour images loaded in to Swanky Paint. Paletted images will be converted to a new 24-bit image (technically 32-bit since the alpha is retained).[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/8a2c6f1a044d7f7df505c75844cfa741f8b02abc.png[/img]
[i]A cat in 4 flavours, with and without attribute clash[/i]

There are 15 base palette choices for dithering, with RGB, HSVC adjustments and an option to build your own base palette. We might add in Gamma for the next stable version (or sooner in the experimental build).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/984873cf8e5f449d8fddf8a9edd4a825d16397b4.png[/img]
[i]Scarborough in MSX, attribute clash[/i]

The Attribute Clash button (flash icon) toggles a preview for before and after dither effects. Hover over the icon and choose the Image Processing window - this window sets the option to enable attribute clash to achieve the effects above.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/5d226a2b00e4b76cad4db93de66bb870d276f4e9.png[/img]
[i]Image Processing window[/i]

[b]Attribute width and height[/b] - Size of each character / tile
[b]Attribute Redux[/b] - Size of reduction (2 colours is traditional for ZXSpectrum)
[b]Attribute Sub[/b] - Size of sub-palette (Groupings of colours)
[b]Attribute Back[/b] - The colour that is allowed to be in each tile (Background colour - defaults to none)

And yes! This can be applied to any base palette so you'll be able to create really unique flavours of glitch art.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/8161745a781c762fefef1f00dd2ece217e51ff79.jpg[/img]
[i]Our dither pattern algorithm[/i]

The default dither pattern in Swanky Paint is an ordered dither, based on an 8x8 tile. This is essentially a Bayer pattern with 65 levels.

[b]We're posting videos of the new features you'll be seeing in the next version of Swanky Paint leading up to the official release party on the 4th of August, 2018 so see you next time![/b]

notes.title: Swanky Paint Alpha +11: Part 1 - ULTIMATE UNDO
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/b6157afdf31f91d62b001ef98a615eba3854d2b7.png[/img]
[i]Feature art - ‘A Pond’ by Frances MacDonald, 1940.[/i]

[h1][b]HELLO![/b]

It’s been some time since the last (stable) version of Swanky Paint was released. If you didn’t know, we’re rolling out releases all the time under the ‘BETA’ opt-in so if you’re ok with experimental builds, join us and let’s squash some bugs together :}[/h1]

We’ve done quite a big rehaul of the infrastructure under the hood. We fixed a bunch of bugs, the user interface has been spruced up to accommodate future features and we’ve streamlined current ones that were hidden before. You should find that things have been moved around quite a bit but they will make more sense under their allocated groupings.

The main new feature we’re excited about is the [b]ULTIMATE UNDO[/b].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TZX6jDO5qWE
Fans of Deluxe Paint should be familiar with the 1 undo of the past and we’ve honoured that tradition - [i]until now[/i].

The ULTIMATE UNDO remembers everything you do from the beginning of an artwork’s inception. It remembers even after you close the file and reopen it again! That's because the history is attached to the image and not the session.

But wait, there's more - [b]you can also save the entire history of an image and export it as a GIF[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/9ce5d44609d9f43f41b25796dfbd0c8601e6bf3a.gif[/img]

Yes, the ULTIMATE UNDO is the most ultimate undo ever conceived!!!!1111oneeleven

We’re able to do this because pixels are oh so very small and the file sizes are negligible. There is a soft limit of 64mb for each history save but you can increase it if you’re really hardcore.

[b]We're posting videos of the new features you'll be seeing in the next version of Swanky Paint leading up to the official release party on the 4th of August, 2018 so see you next time![/b]

notes.title: New update, more fixes for Mac OS!
notes.content:
The previous update that fixed the issue with AMD drivers on Windows 10 machines unfortunately broke on Mac OS machines.

This was due to versions of GLSL supported by different architectures.

We've now updated a new version which should fix loading on Mac OS machines.

Many thanks for your patience and your support!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25267937/13071e4b3287783efea7dfc3fe3c5e8e31e5a76a.png[/img]
